headline: Deutsche Bank Rolls Out Agentic AI for Wealth Checks in Asia
evidence: Deutsche Bank Private Bank has introduced an agentic AI tool in Singapore and Hong Kong to support source-of-wealth checks, as it prepares for higher client onboarding volumes.
notes: Named bank, named task, and a date it went live. The Private Bank's agentic tool runs source-of-wealth checks at the Singapore and Hong Kong booking centres from early September, with Dubai advisers on Singapore-booked accounts too.

headline: GoCardless processes first agentic account-to-account transaction in the UK
task: processed the first agentic account-to-account transaction
evidence: Bank payment company GoCardless has processed the first agentic account-to-account transaction in the UK, an AI-driven donation on its website for Trussell, the anti-poverty charity and community of food banks.
notes: A completed transaction, not an intention: an AI-driven donation to Trussell paid account-to-account. Graded pilot rather than in production because a first transaction on the company's own website is a showcase, the same call made on the Mastercard and Trip.com piece.

headline: Danske Bank performs AI agent transaction with Mastercard
task: carried out both the purchase and the payment on behalf of a consumer
evidence: Mastercard and Danske Bank have completed a payment in which an AI agent, acting on behalf of a consumer, carried out both the purchase and the payment.
notes: Named bank, named scheme, and a payment that happened: an agent acting for a consumer carried out both the purchase and the payment. Pilot, for the same reason as the GoCardless first above.
